core_obligations: Show the construction of example-family-associated-closed is compatible with base change, restriction, and flat pullback (proof lines 760-764). Taking F = (Z -> X)_* O_Z, the closed subscheme construction is a special case of the module construction: by chow-lemma-cycle-closed-coherent (tag 02QY) the cycle associated to the closed subscheme Z is the cycle associated to the pushforward of its structure sheaf, and the module construction's compatibility with the three operations is lemma-family-associated-module (tag 0H4R) (proof lines 761-763).
proof_roadmap: Identify the closed subscheme construction with the module construction via F = (Z -> X)_* O_Z (proof lines 761-762).
Transfer the three compatibilities from the module construction, sewing with the Chow Homology closed-coherent lemma (proof lines 762-763).
